messages:
maya: hey SF folks — i'll be in-office wed/thu this week, thinking of ordering lunch for hybrid day. quick poll: bagels from Melt & Grain (Market St) vs poke bowls from Blue Bowl vs sushi from Sushi Moto — any other recs? :thinking_face:
sam: bagels are safe but i need gluten-free. does Melt & Grain do GF bagels?
jordan: Melt & Grain has a GF oat option but they run out early. Blue Bowl has a solid tofu poke (vegan), and they do brown rice.
katie: sushi is nice but longer wait. my vote: poke if we can do group pickup quickly. :+1:
leah: voted poke! dairy-free here.
maya: tally so far: poke 2, bagel 1. budget target is ~$12-15pp. anyone more opinions?
sam: $15 max for me. also can't pick up — slammed with calls until 12:30.
maya: i can pick up if needed. please reply with this order format so i can consolidate:
```
Name — item — mods/allergies — pickup (office/contactless)
```
jordan: Jordan — Spicy Tofu Poke — no raw onion — office
leah: Leah — Avocado Poke — dairy-free — office
katie: Katie — Salmon Poke — extra wasabi — contactless (i'll meet maya outside)
sam: Sam — GF Bagel w/ plain schmear — gluten-free — office (fallback if poke sells out)
ops-bot: heads-up: team lunch budget needs finance approval for orders > $150. ping @finance if > 12 people.
maya: noted ops-bot. looks like 4 confirmed so far, keeping under budget. i'll place the order at 11:45. thanks! :thumbsup:
sam: thank you maya :heart:
leah: lunch hype :tada:
maya: FYI Blue Bowl menu: https://bluebowl.example/menu — they can do pickup by 11:50, and will box separately for allergies. i'll DM payment prefs and Venmo if anyone owes me.
jordan: also adding a small note: if anyone's remote and wants delivery to the lobby window, comment here and i'll coordinate.
katie: adding link for sign-up for part-timers: https://redwood-internal/forms/lunch-signup — helps avoid duplicates.
maya: great. see y'all weds. :bento:
